card.name: Words just before a direction of change
card.fires_on: Linking words such as may, that, who, or the choice word declining, shorter, or lower, where the text is about to say whether a level goes up or down. Mostly in drug interaction sentences about CYP3A inhibitors and inducers changing drug concentrations.

modes.label: Interaction verbs
modes.description: Words like may or that after inhibitors or inducers of an enzyme, just before increase or decrease.
modes.example: Inhibitors of CYP3A4 may increase ruxolitinib systemic concentrations whereas inducers of CYP3A4<< may>> decrease ruxolitinib systemic concentrations

modes.label: Either-or direction words
modes.description: The second option in a pair such as higher or lower, or accumulating or declining.
modes.example: In practice, the inflated price may be higher or<< lower>> than the calculated one.
